hints.title: Bitwise OR Plus One Structure
hints.text: Computing x or (x + 1) sets all trailing zeros of x to ones, leaving other bits unchanged.

hints.title: Even Prime Impossibility
hints.text: Since x or (x + 1) is always odd for any non-negative integer x, the even prime 2 cannot be formed. Set ans[i] = -1 for 2.

hints.title: Lowest Unset Bit Turning
hints.text: For any odd prime, locate the lowest unset bit index i. Turning off the bit at position i - 1 yields the minimal x satisfying the equation.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: At most 30 bit operations per prime number.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force loop from 0 to p is unnecessary and slower.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies trailing 1s carry behavior in bitwise x OR (x + 1).
